query:
UPDATE git_sync_ci_test_check
         SET concluded = true, github_posted = true, concluded_at = now(),
             conclusion = COALESCE(conclusion, 'failure')
         WHERE (check_run_id IS NULL AND NOT concluded
                AND created_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1))
            OR (concluded AND NOT github_posted
                AND concluded_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $2))
